paper_claims.statement: PBFM uses training-time residual and conflict-free gradient objectives;Table1 explicitly marks hard constraints absent. Reported Pareto improvement concerns compared configurations.
paper_claims.caveat: No global Pareto-optimality certificate or universal feasible-output guarantee is independently established.

paper_claims.statement: The printed ConFIG construction normalizes gradients and orthogonal components and asserts simultaneous descent.
paper_claims.caveat: Its displayed divisions require nonzero denominators;this source reading does not certify degeneracy handling or global optimization.

paper_claims.statement: Endpoint unrolling improves residual evaluation during training and increases training cost;inference does not add a physics projection.
paper_claims.caveat: Numerical endpoint approximation and learned-model accuracy remain distinct;training overhead cannot be omitted from a deployment budget.

paper_claims.statement: Algorithm1 squares the norm of a time-scaled residual;the source discusses p=1 and other power exponents.
paper_claims.caveat: The current released training implementation requires a separate formula/shape audit rather than assuming identity from the method name.

paper_claims.statement: Dynamic-stall zero added noise has the best printed RE/WD/JS values,but not the best printed mean/std errors.
paper_claims.caveat: A residual-vs-noise heuristic is task,operator,normalization and metric dependent;it is not a manufacturing tolerance.

paper_claims.statement: Darcy has64x64pressure/permeability fields,10k train/1k validation samples,and no conditioning inputs. Reference permeability is exp(G)>0.
paper_claims.caveat: Authors note limited real-world representativeness. Training/data residuals share finite-difference stencils,not independent metrology.

paper_claims.statement: Kolmogorov conditions on Reynolds number100-500;training32conditions and validation16conditions use a spectral solver and the generated velocity divergence residual.
paper_claims.caveat: A divergence check is a specified mass-consistency endpoint;it does not establish all Navier-Stokes dynamics or an unseen manufacturing process.

paper_claims.statement: Dynamic stall is simulated pitching NACA0012 RANS data with four operating inputs and six spatiotemporal fields;training128nominal conditions and test16nominal conditions each have32perturbations.
paper_claims.caveat: Treat perturbations as nested within conditions. Algebraic ideal-gas and skin-friction checks are not a full independent RANS/manufacturing certificate.

paper_claims.statement: The printed skin-friction relation uses a positive norm,while the dataset description includes signed skin friction.
paper_claims.caveat: The released code includes tangent-based sign handling;do not infer that its actual residual is the unsigned printed expression.

paper_claims.statement: Darcy Table2 calls RE MSE while Figures3-4 refer to MAE;the released sample path computes absolute residual means.
paper_claims.caveat: Metric identity remains unresolved;our measured MAE is not numeric reproduction of a displayed MSE caption.

paper_claims.statement: The main D-Flow comparison keeps888of1024samples underRE<5;the Scale variant keeps403. Some main comparators use UNet while PBFM usesDiT.
paper_claims.caveat: Selected-case and architecture differences restrict causal attribution of cross-method improvements.

paper_claims.statement: For PBFM,t*=0.2 improves printed WD relative to deterministic sampling while RE changes0.828to0.838. VanillaFM Table11 stochastic rows reduce RE but all displayed WD values exceed its deterministic0.059.
paper_claims.caveat: Stochasticity is not a universal all-metric improvement. Preserve threshold and model recipe;no mode superiority is established by our32+32pilot.

paper_claims.statement: Table4 displays PBFM SMSE2.484 versusFM2.574 and MMSE4.455 versusFM4.188,both with their column scales. Prose says standard-deviation error is slightly higher.
paper_claims.caveat: Retain a source reporting discrepancy;do not infer statistical significance or silently swap the endpoint.

paper_claims.statement: Dynamic-stall PCFM has the smallest printed RE0.143 versusPBFM0.339,but larger WD,mean/std errors and reported time.
paper_claims.caveat: Column scales and compared implementations are retained;this is not our independently executed dynamic-stall comparison.

paper_claims.statement: For128dynamic-stall outputs,Table10 reportsGPU0.198s/CPU119s at10steps,andGPU0.413s/CPU240s at20steps,withbatch128.
paper_claims.caveat: The discussion combines4CPUminutes with0.2GPUseconds;these belong to different step counts. Do not construct a single20step operating point or compare them with single-sample latency.

paper_claims.statement: An author-reported conventional simulation uses76minutes on8XeonCPUcores,whereas generator timing varies withbatch size and steps.
paper_claims.caveat: These are simulated engineering tasks,not measured plant throughput,end-to-end production cost,or a rights-cleared manufacturing use.

paper_claims.statement: The4step training rows are configuration-specific:Darcy44.15GB/0.159s versusFM12.35GB/0.0428s;Kolmogorov0.518s versusone-stepPBFM0.194s.
paper_claims.caveat: The summary up-to3xmemory/2.5xtime is approximate and baseline-dependent. Hardware is recorded as the authors report it,not an inference minimum.

paper_claims.statement: The Darcy visual comparisons select similar variable ranges;Fig10 compares DiT and UNet without residual loss. Figure11 negative colorbar values are on pressure fields.
paper_claims.caveat: Visual checking rejects the tentative interpretation that those negative labels establish negative permeability. They are not our raw-array positivity result.

paper_claims.statement: Fig10 error bars are validation-sample minima/maxima;Fig16 bars concern different conditioning values.
